name: AL Language XApp A
brief: Cross-app fixture A: the base app of the cross-app fixtures.
description: Holds the integration event of the cross-app subscriber order probe, tables that other apps extend, and a Company Triggers counter. Depends on no app. The AL Language Coverage Tests app and the other cross-app fixtures depend on it. The app id, name and publisher are fixed on purpose: they decide the candidate orders of the cross-app subscriber order probe (CONTRIBUTING.md, "Multi-app fixtures"). Do not change them.
